description: Bind evidence and approval to tasks; simplify Channel CLI defaults
changelog: New evidence briefs and queues require a task-owned unit plan, workload rationale, and grouping rationale for multiple scope items. FIFO claims cannot skip earlier unclaimed units. Bundled Channel guidance exposes one-host multi-target dispatch, rolling accepted-slot refill, and drain before context selection. Native task select preserves phase/branch; planned change-bearing start requires current material plan seal and later approval, while replan invalidates them. Channel CLI derives the subnode role and provider from --profile and defaults author identity to TRELLIS_CHANNEL_AS or main, removing redundant options while keeping worker IDs and recipients explicit.
notes: Upgrade the paired CLI/core release and run trellis update; refresh explicitly selected Marketplace workflows from an immutable ref. Classify legacy planning tasks once before start. Preserve historical reports and existing in-progress tasks; no bulk queue/history migration or scheduler is introduced. Approval records check structural consistency, not chat authenticity. Native ordinary continue/compaction retains its checkpoint fast path. No runtime migration is required.
